diff --git a/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql b/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..fbb1f3bc20b2cea70b7d8fd8f0878fc3e6c37f40
--- /dev/null
+++ b/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+-- The stream which a workshop broadcasts becomes its paid recording once the
+-- workshop ends. An offset lets that replay skip the waiting room without
+-- publishing and maintaining a second, trimmed copy of the same video.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.workshops
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recording_start_offset_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+        CHECK (recording_start_offset_seconds >= 0);
+
+COMMIT;

 # Current preversion
 
+- Added a configurable start offset in seconds to the stage settings of `/admin/workshops`. After an online workshop
+  ends, `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` now opens the paid member replay at that position, so the same
+  uploaded stream can skip its empty waiting room without a second trimmed upload. The countdown and live stream are
+  unchanged; members without replay access still receive only the existing teaser or membership offer.
+
 - Placed the community material of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` by what the member reading it has: a
   participant who does not pay for the membership is invited into the community before the materials of the workshop,
   while a paying member keeps that invitation at the end of the list as one more way on. The card itself, its link and

diff --git a/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql b/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..fbb1f3bc20b2cea70b7d8fd8f0878fc3e6c37f40
--- /dev/null
+++ b/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+-- The stream which a workshop broadcasts becomes its paid recording once the
+-- workshop ends. An offset lets that replay skip the waiting room without
+-- publishing and maintaining a second, trimmed copy of the same video.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.workshops
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recording_start_offset_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+        CHECK (recording_start_offset_seconds >= 0);
+
+COMMIT;

 # Current preversion
 
+- Added a configurable start offset in seconds to the stage settings of `/admin/workshops`. After an online workshop
+  ends, `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` now opens the paid member replay at that position, so the same
+  uploaded stream can skip its empty waiting room without a second trimmed upload. The countdown and live stream are
+  unchanged; members without replay access still receive only the existing teaser or membership offer.
+
 - Placed the community material of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` by what the member reading it has: a
   participant who does not pay for the membership is invited into the community before the materials of the workshop,
   while a paying member keeps that invitation at the end of the list as one more way on. The card itself, its link and

+-- The stream which a workshop broadcasts becomes its paid recording once the
+-- workshop ends. An offset lets that replay skip the waiting room without
+-- publishing and maintaining a second, trimmed copy of the same video.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.workshops
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recording_start_offset_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+        CHECK (recording_start_offset_seconds >= 0);
+
+COMMIT;

 # Current preversion
 
+- Added a configurable start offset in seconds to the stage settings of `/admin/workshops`. After an online workshop
+  ends, `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` now opens the paid member replay at that position, so the same
+  uploaded stream can skip its empty waiting room without a second trimmed upload. The countdown and live stream are
+  unchanged; members without replay access still receive only the existing teaser or membership offer.
+
 - Placed the community material of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` by what the member reading it has: a
   participant who does not pay for the membership is invited into the community before the materials of the workshop,
   while a paying member keeps that invitation at the end of the list as one more way on. The card itself, its link and

+-- The stream which a workshop broadcasts becomes its paid recording once the
+-- workshop ends. An offset lets that replay skip the waiting room without
+-- publishing and maintaining a second, trimmed copy of the same video.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.workshops
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recording_start_offset_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+        CHECK (recording_start_offset_seconds >= 0);
+
+COMMIT;

 # Current preversion
 
+- Added a configurable start offset in seconds to the stage settings of `/admin/workshops`. After an online workshop
+  ends, `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` now opens the paid member replay at that position, so the same
+  uploaded stream can skip its empty waiting room without a second trimmed upload. The countdown and live stream are
+  unchanged; members without replay access still receive only the existing teaser or membership offer.
+
 - Placed the community material of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` by what the member reading it has: a
   participant who does not pay for the membership is invited into the community before the materials of the workshop,
   while a paying member keeps that invitation at the end of the list as one more way on. The card itself, its link and

diff --git a/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql b/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..fbb1f3bc20b2cea70b7d8fd8f0878fc3e6c37f40
--- /dev/null
+++ b/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+-- The stream which a workshop broadcasts becomes its paid recording once the
+-- workshop ends. An offset lets that replay skip the waiting room without
+-- publishing and maintaining a second, trimmed copy of the same video.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.workshops
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recording_start_offset_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+        CHECK (recording_start_offset_seconds >= 0);
+
+COMMIT;

apply patch

 # Current preversion
 
+- Added a configurable start offset in seconds to the stage settings of `/admin/workshops`. After an online workshop
+  ends, `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` now opens the paid member replay at that position, so the same
+  uploaded stream can skip its empty waiting room without a second trimmed upload. The countdown and live stream are
+  unchanged; members without replay access still receive only the existing teaser or membership offer.
+
 - Placed the community material of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` by what the member reading it has: a
   participant who does not pay for the membership is invited into the community before the materials of the workshop,
   while a paying member keeps that invitation at the end of the list as one more way on. The card itself, its link and

diff --git a/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql b/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..fbb1f3bc20b2cea70b7d8fd8f0878fc3e6c37f40
--- /dev/null
+++ b/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+-- The stream which a workshop broadcasts becomes its paid recording once the
+-- workshop ends. An offset lets that replay skip the waiting room without
+-- publishing and maintaining a second, trimmed copy of the same video.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.workshops
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recording_start_offset_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+        CHECK (recording_start_offset_seconds >= 0);
+
+COMMIT;

 # Current preversion
 
+- Added a configurable start offset in seconds to the stage settings of `/admin/workshops`. After an online workshop
+  ends, `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` now opens the paid member replay at that position, so the same
+  uploaded stream can skip its empty waiting room without a second trimmed upload. The countdown and live stream are
+  unchanged; members without replay access still receive only the existing teaser or membership offer.
+
 - Placed the community material of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` by what the member reading it has: a
   participant who does not pay for the membership is invited into the community before the materials of the workshop,
   while a paying member keeps that invitation at the end of the list as one more way on. The card itself, its link and

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+-- The stream which a workshop broadcasts becomes its paid recording once the
+-- workshop ends. An offset lets that replay skip the waiting room without
+-- publishing and maintaining a second, trimmed copy of the same video.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.workshops
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recording_start_offset_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+        CHECK (recording_start_offset_seconds >= 0);
+
+COMMIT;

 # Current preversion
 
+- Added a configurable start offset in seconds to the stage settings of `/admin/workshops`. After an online workshop
+  ends, `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` now opens the paid member replay at that position, so the same
+  uploaded stream can skip its empty waiting room without a second trimmed upload. The countdown and live stream are
+  unchanged; members without replay access still receive only the existing teaser or membership offer.
+
 - Placed the community material of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` by what the member reading it has: a
   participant who does not pay for the membership is invited into the community before the materials of the workshop,
   while a paying member keeps that invitation at the end of the list as one more way on. The card itself, its link and

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+-- The stream which a workshop broadcasts becomes its paid recording once the
+-- workshop ends. An offset lets that replay skip the waiting room without
+-- publishing and maintaining a second, trimmed copy of the same video.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.workshops
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recording_start_offset_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+        CHECK (recording_start_offset_seconds >= 0);
+
+COMMIT;

diff --git a/changelog/_current-preversion.md b/changelog/_current-preversion.md
index eb4204a85d1ccf5e37fbe2ed5066bba28c438da7..1b75dcf98d2cd2925f23914f9a8ead2213d4754f
--- a/changelog/_current-preversion.md
+++ b/changelog/_current-preversion.md
@@ -1,5 +1,10 @@
 # Current preversion
 
+- Added a configurable start offset in seconds to the stage settings of `/admin/workshops`. After an online workshop
+  ends, `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` now opens the paid member replay at that position, so the same
+  uploaded stream can skip its empty waiting room without a second trimmed upload. The countdown and live stream are
+  unchanged; members without replay access still receive only the existing teaser or membership offer.
+
 - Placed the community material of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` by what the member reading it has: a

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+-- The stream which a workshop broadcasts becomes its paid recording once the
+-- workshop ends. An offset lets that replay skip the waiting room without
+-- publishing and maintaining a second, trimmed copy of the same video.
+
+BEGIN;

 # Current preversion
 
+- Added a configurable start offset in seconds to the stage settings of `/admin/workshops`. After an online workshop
+  ends, `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` now opens the paid member replay at that position, so the same
+  uploaded stream can skip its empty waiting room without a second trimmed upload. The countdown and live stream are
+  unchanged; members without replay access still receive only the existing teaser or membership offer.
+
 - Placed the community material of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` by what the member reading it has: a
   participant who does not pay for the membership is invited into the community before the materials of the workshop,
   while a paying member keeps that invitation at the end of the list as one more way on. The card itself, its link and

diff --git a/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql b/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..fbb1f3bc20b2cea70b7d8fd8f0878fc3e6c37f40
--- /dev/null
+++ b/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+-- The stream which a workshop broadcasts becomes its paid recording once the
+-- workshop ends. An offset lets that replay skip the waiting room without
+-- publishing and maintaining a second, trimmed copy of the same video.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.workshops
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recording_start_offset_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+        CHECK (recording_start_offset_seconds >= 0);
+
+COMMIT;

codex
Implemented the replay start offset.

- `/admin/workshops` now has “Začít záznam od (sekundy)” and saves a non-negative whole-second offset.
- Paid members’ post-workshop replay uses YouTube’s `start` parameter; countdown and live stream remain unchanged.
- The existing server-side membership gate also protects the offset/video selection.
- Added migration [2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/migrations/2026-09-1600-workshop-recording-start-offset.sql:8), changelog entry, tests, and cache versioning.

Key implementation: [admin setting](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/businesses/workshop-admin/WorkshopSettingsForm.tsx:289), [replay embed](/C:/Users/me/work/promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages/aldaron/businesses/online-workshop/participant/WorkshopStage.tsx:181).

Verified focused Vitest suites and `npx tsc --noEmit`.

Apply the new migration through the normal deployment/startup migration flow. Unrelated existing changes in `package.json` and the prompt file were left untouched.

 # Current preversion
 
+- Added a configurable start offset in seconds to the stage settings of `/admin/workshops`. After an online workshop
+  ends, `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` now opens the paid member replay at that position, so the same
+  uploaded stream can skip its empty waiting room without a second trimmed upload. The countdown and live stream are
+  unchanged; members without replay access still receive only the existing teaser or membership offer.
+
 - Placed the community material of `/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=` by what the member reading it has: a
   participant who does not pay for the membership is invited into the community before the materials of the workshop,
   while a paying member keeps that invitation at the end of the list as one more way on. The card itself, its link and

+-- The stream which a workshop broadcasts becomes its paid recording once the
+-- workshop ends. An offset lets that replay skip the waiting room without
+-- publishing and maintaining a second, trimmed copy of the same video.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.workshops
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recording_start_offset_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
+        CHECK (recording_start_offset_seconds >= 0);
+
+COMMIT;
